description_en: Updates a single feature in the Thing Specification Language (TSL) model of a specified product and supports updating extended descriptions of the TSL model
description_zh: 更新指定产品物模型中的单个功能，支持更新物模型扩展描述
name: UpdateThingModel

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Instances page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If an ID value is available, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If no <props="intl"><ph>Instances page or </ph></props>ID value is available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无<props="intl"><ph>实例概览页面或</ph></props>ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The ProductKey of the product.

You can view the ProductKey on the Products page in the IoT Platform console, or call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html operation to query the ProductKey
parameters.help_zh:
产品的ProductKey。

可以在物联网平台控制台产品页查看，或调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/69271.html查看ProductKey的取值
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The original identifier of the feature.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150319.html operation and view the identifier of the specific feature from the TslStr response parameter
parameters.help_zh:
功能原有的标识符。

您可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150319.html，从返回参数**TslStr**中查看具体功能的**identifier**
parameters.name: identifier

parameters.help_en:
The new feature definition details.

If Identifier is not empty, it indicates that the identifier of the feature is updated. The definition of up to one feature identifier can be included.
If Identifier is empty, it indicates that the definitions of input or output parameters under a service or event are updated. The definitions of multiple parameters can be included, up to a maximum of 50.

For guidelines on writing ThingModelJson, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150457.html
parameters.help_zh:
新的功能定义详情。

Identifier不为空时，表示更新功能的标识符，最多能包含1个功能的标识符定义信息。
Identifier为空时，表示更新一个服务或事件下，输入或输出参数的定义，可包含多个参数的定义信息，最多不超过50个。

ThingModelJson的编写指导，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/150457.html
parameters.name: thing_model_json

parameters.help_en:
The identifier of the custom TSL module, which is unique within the product.

If neither this parameter nor FunctionBlockName is specified, the feature in the default module is updated
parameters.help_zh:
物模型自定义模块标识符，在产品中具有唯一性。

此参数和FunctionBlockName均不传入时，更新默认模块中功能
parameters.name: function_block_id

parameters.help_en:
The name of the custom TSL module. The name can contain Chinese characters, English letters, Japanese characters, digits, and underscores (_). It must be 4 to 30 characters in length. One Chinese or Japanese character counts as one character.

If neither this parameter nor FunctionBlockId is specified, the feature in the default module is updated.

If this parameter is specified, it must be used together with FunctionBlockId to modify the name of the custom module corresponding to the FunctionBlockId.

The name of the default module cannot be modified
parameters.help_zh:
物模型的自定义模块名称。支持中文、英文字母、日文、数字和下划线（_），长度限制为4～30个字符，一个中文、一个日文算1个字符。

此参数和FunctionBlockId均不传入时，更新默认模块中功能。

如果传入此参数，必须与FunctionBlockId结合使用，可修改FunctionBlockId对应的自定义模块名称。

不支持修改默认模块名称
parameters.name: function_block_name

false: The call failed

true：调用成功。
